reply_text:
I posted a reply in your DM. I did not set up the 09:00 digest.

The scheduling tool available to me runs jobs locally and does not deliver output into this Slack workspace, so a digest would not reliably reach your DM each morning. I told you that in the DM, but I should be more precise: the limit is delivery, not scheduling in general.

What I can do now is post a 'Coastal team digest' of #coastal-team whenever you ask in this DM. Give me a window, such as "since yesterday" or "last 7 days," and I'll read the channel and post it here. Your DM is the only place I have replied so far.
